home.title: Relive every race
home.lead: Pick a season, Grand Prix and session to watch the 3D replay with telemetry, timeline and race control.

selector.error: The session catalogue could not be loaded.
selector.pickEvent: Pick a Grand Prix to see its sessions.
selector.unavailableHint: No position data: it cannot be replayed.

error.not-found: This session does not exist or is no longer available.
error.network: The data could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
error.unsupported-version: This data needs a newer version of Trazada. Reload the page to update it.
error.invalid-manifest: The session description is not valid.
error.no-position: This session has no position data, so it cannot be replayed.
error.corrupt: The downloaded data is damaged (integrity check failed).
error.decode: The session data could not be decoded.

scene.noWebgl: Your browser or device does not support WebGL 2: the 3D map is unavailable.
scene.noWebglHint: Enable hardware acceleration or try another browser.
scene.contextLost: The graphics context was lost (the GPU was reset or ran out of memory).
scene.exaggerationHint: Track height is multiplied so the elevation change is visible: it is not the real one.
scene.flatHint: This session's data has no reliable altitude.
